description: Octopus superhero: coral-red octopus skin with pale sucker-pink tentacle tips, a gold goggle mask and gold chest emblem as the heroic accent, glowing white-cyan lenses, a dark beak; royal-blue cape tentacles with a pale sucker-side lining and lighter tips, joined by translucent-reading pale cyan WATER webs with a bright glowing free edge.

skin.note: octopus body: torso, arm and leg tentacles

head.note: the mantle (head) - a touch lighter than the body

arm_tip.note: arm tentacle paddle tips - pale sucker pink

leg_tip.note: leg tentacle tips - pale sucker pink

mouth.note: the beak/mouth - deep maroon (dark enough to read as an opening, not so dark it reads as a moustache)

cape_under.note: cape tentacle lining (sucker side, faces the body) - pale periwinkle

membrane.note: WATER webs between the cape tentacles - pale cyan, soft inner glow (reads translucent)

membrane_rim.note: the webs' free edge - bright water/foam glow (top glow tier)
